body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 2-unit line of ground within 5 units. Creatures in it compare against Fortitude; on a success, they become Prone and the line becomes difficult terrain until your next turn.

surges.html: Increase the line's length by 1 unit.
Choose one creature this Action succeeds against; make it Chilled or Corroded.

rider.title: EARTH THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action that would knock a creature Prone or move it; increase that effect by 1.
